lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most specific kinds of change, as only 'home, wait_info', 'finish, new_screen', 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', and 'choose_path, copy' have been tested at least twice.
'home, wait_info' is helpful, supported by three winning tests out of four (+3.1% average after noise correction).
'finish, new_screen' is helpful overall, with two winning tests out of three (+3.9% average after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for both 'adoption, notification' and 'sign_in, incentive', as all tests for these kinds resulted in no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one lost: worse, one won), so no clear pattern has been established.
Predictions were generally too high for unhelpful changes, but underpredicted gains on several winning tests (such as in 'home, wait_info' and 'choose_path, copy').

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for most kinds of change; only seven kinds (home wait_info, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, adoption notification, sign_in incentive, sign_in hint, and adoption layout) have at least 2 tests.
'home, wait_info' is helpful, supported by three winning tests out of five (+2.7% average after noise correction).
'finish, new_screen' is helpful overall, with two winning tests out of four (+2.2% average after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', 'sign_in, hint', and 'adoption, layout', as all tests for these kinds resulted in no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one lost: worse, one won), so no clear pattern has been established.
